description: higgsfield-superengine spend guard (Python: py -3 on Windows; hooks/hf-guard.sh on Mac/Linux, which finds Python itself. Each entry passes --only-on, so exactly one guard decides per OS). On Bash/PowerShell/Monitor/Write/Edit: a paid hf_rest submit is priced and checked against the spend cap, then stamped (allow) or asked (a real click); raw api.higgsfield.ai calls, the higgsfield CLI/SDK, other ways into hf_rest and edits to the guard's files are denied; everything else passes untouched. Fails closed on Higgsfield commands. The no-look screen guard was removed in 0.1.4. The routing hint (route_hint, in this folder) is built but not registered until Jev passes testing.
